power.neoorigins.sporeling_mushroom_buff: Ko te Symbiosis o te Hoko
Ka whakahoutia te hauora i roto i nga koiora o te huaketo.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_fungal_contac: Ka whakaora i te 1 HP ia hēkona i te wā e tu ana i runga i ngā kōpaki hongi, i roto rānei ranei i te mycelium.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_natural_armor: Te ātete pūmau I Ka whakapakeketia te tipu o te fungus i nga whiu katoa.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_daylight_dama: Ko te Rā e Whakatika ana
Ka tango i te 1 kino ia hēkona ina whakauruhia ki te mahana o te ra.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_slow_movement: E neke ana i te 10% iti ake i te ritenga.
origins.neoorigins.frostborn.name: Frostborn
origins.neoorigins.frostborn.description: Ko te huānga o te hukarere me te makariri ka whakarewa i nga hoariri, ka tupu i roto i te taigas, engari ko te ahi me te Nether e whakangaro ana.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_freeze_aura.d: Ka pupuhi i ngā hoariri e tata ana, he tino puhoi, he roa te kaha, he 10 hēkona te whakawera.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_cold_buff.des: Ka whiwhi kaha i te wā i roto i te koiora taiga makariri.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_fire_weakness: E rua nga kino i puta mai i te ahi.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_ice_walk.name: Te haere i runga i te hukarere
power.neoorigins.frostborn_ice_walk.desc: Ka whakanohoia he hukarere ki te kōpae e titiro ana koe. He whakawera kotahi hēkona.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_natural_armor: Ko te ātete pumau I te hukarere o te hukarere e huri ana i nga whiu katoa.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_nether_damage: E rua ngā kino i ia hēkona i roto i te Nether.
power.neoorigins.frostborn_freeze_immuni: He tino ārai ki te kino o te kōpeke.
origins.neoorigins.strider.name: Ko te Strider
origins.neoorigins.strider.description: He mea ora o Netherland e hikoi ana i runga i te hau me te whakaora i roto i tona mahana engari ko te ao makariri me te wai e whakangaro ana.
power.neoorigins.strider_fire_immunity.n: Ko te whanau o te wai
power.neoorigins.strider_fire_immunity.d: E ārai ana ki te ahi, ki te hau, ki ngā kōpae magma, ki te tahu hoki.
power.neoorigins.strider_nether_buff.des: Ka piki ake te tere i a ia e noho ana i te Nether.
E rua nga kino i ia hēkona i roto i te wai, i te ua rānei.
power.neoorigins.strider_lava_regen.name: Te Whakaora i te Magma
power.neoorigins.strider_lava_regen.desc: Ka whakaora i te 2 HP i te tuarua i te wa e taka ana i roto i te hau.
power.neoorigins.strider_night_vision.de: Ka taea te kite mārama i roto i te pōuri tonu. Whakamahia te paatene Night Vision (te taunoa K).
power.neoorigins.strider_overworld_slown: He pōhēhē i roto i te ao makariri.
power.neoorigins.strider_natural_armor.d: Te ātete pūmau I Ko te kiri kua whakapakeketia e te magma ka pakaru i te pānga.
origins.neoorigins.siren.name: Ko te pūāhua
origins.neoorigins.siren.description: Ko tētahi kaitiaki wai i whanau i te moana tuwhera e whakamiharo ana i ngā mea ora me te noho whakamiharo me te whakaora i roto i te ngaru, engari he ngoikore, he puhoi, a ka maroke ki te whenua.
power.neoorigins.siren_charm.name: Te Tūturu Whakapono
power.neoorigins.siren_charm.description: Ka whakakorehia koe e ngā hui katoa, ki te kore koe e whakaeke i a rātou i te tuatahi.
power.neoorigins.siren_water_breathing.d: E manawa ana i raro i te wai ki te mutunga kore, ka kite mārama i roto i te wai me te kore e haumanu.
power.neoorigins.siren_aquatic_speed.des: He nui ake te tere o tana kaukau i te kaitākaro noa.
power.neoorigins.siren_night_vision.name: Ko nga kanohi moana
power.neoorigins.siren_night_vision.desc: Ka taea e koe te kite mārama i roto i nga hohonu pouri. Whakamahia te paatene Night Vision (K taunoa).
power.neoorigins.siren_land_slowdown.des: E neke ana i te 15% iti ake i runga i te whenua.
power.neoorigins.siren_reduced_health.de: -2 ngā ngakau (-4 HP mōrahi). He ngoikore, he waiata-hanga kāore i hangaia mō ngā whiu.
power.neoorigins.siren_regen_in_water.de: Ka whakaora i te 1 HP ia hēkona i te wai.
power.neoorigins.siren_dries_out.name: Ka maroke
power.neoorigins.siren_dries_out.descrip: Ka heke te hau i te wa e kore ai koe e wai: he roa rawa te mata, a ka mate koe. Ko te ua, ko te kohua wai, ko te manawa wai, ko te rori mahi tata rānei, e aukati ana i a koe.
origins.neoorigins.piglin.name: Ko te poaka
origins.neoorigins.piglin.description: He toa Nether kua pakaru ki te koura kaha i te kāinga, e wehi ana i te whanaunga, engari i ngoikore i waho o te Nether.
power.neoorigins.piglin_nether_buff.name: Ko Nether Fury
power.neoorigins.piglin_nether_buff.desc: Ka whiwhi i te kaha II i a ia e noho ana i te Nether.
power.neoorigins.piglin_gold_affinity.de: E kore e whakaekehia koe e Piglins me Piglin Brutes.
power.neoorigins.piglin_fire_immunity.de: E ārai ana ki te ahi, ki te hau, ki ngā kōpae magma, me ngā kino katoa e tahuna ana.
power.neoorigins.piglin_attack_bonus.des: E rua ngā pānga anō mō ia pānga.
power.neoorigins.piglin_overworld_weakne: I whiua e te ngoikoretanga i te wa e noho ana i te ao o waho.
power.neoorigins.piglin_night_vision.des: Ka kite mārama i te pōuri. Pāwhiritia ki te pātene Tirohanga Po (K taunoa).
power.neoorigins.piglin_soul_fire_damage: Ka wera te ahi wairua i te hohonu e 0.5 nga kino i ia tuarua i te wa e noho ana koe i roto i te Raorao oneone o te wairua.
origins.neoorigins.hiveling.name: Te whakatere
origins.neoorigins.hiveling.description: Ko tētahi huakita pēnei i te ngeru e rere noa ana, e whiu ana i ngā hoariri me te patu mate, ā, e whakakotahi ana i ngā hua kia tupu.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_flight.name: Nga Rapa Whatiwhati
power.neoorigins.hiveling_flight.descrip: Ka rere rite ki te kaiwhakamahi Elytra nga parirau o te ngeru e pupuhi ana, ka pēhi ki te peke i te wa e hinga ana kia rere.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_sting.name: Te ngenge kino
power.neoorigins.hiveling_sting.descript: E pupuhi ana i tētahi pōti kino ki tō whāinga, kotahi te pūngao, e ono nga hēkona te whakawera.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_crop_growth.de: He tere ake te tipu o ngā hua e tata ana ki a koe.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_size.name: Pāpāho Iti
power.neoorigins.hiveling_size.descripti: 60% te rahi o te kaitākaro noa.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_entity_group.d: Kua whakarōpūtia hei arthropod he ngoikore ki te Bane o Arthropods.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_jump_boost.des: +40% te kaha o te peke ngā waewae o te ngeru e piki ake ana koe.
power.neoorigins.hiveling_hunger_drain.d: He 50% te tere o te pūngao e tahuna ana he uaua te rere.
origins.neoorigins.cinderborn.name: Ko Cinderborn
origins.neoorigins.cinderborn.descriptio: He ahi a te ahi o te aorangi e kore e kaha ki te mura, e whakamataku ana ki nga kararehe, a ka ora i te lava engari ka pakaru i te wai.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_fire_immunit: He ārai ki te ahi, ki te hau, ki ngā kōpaki magma, me te tahunga ka whakakakahu te kiri o te oumu.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_fireball.des: Ka pupuhi i ngā pōro ahi iti e wha ki te aronga e titiro ana koe.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_natural_armo: Ko te Whakaaetanga Tuuturu I whakarewahia te magma e whakakahore ana i nga patu.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_lava_regen.d: Ka whakaora i te 1 HP ia hēkona i te wā e hopu ana i roto i te hau.
Ka whiwhi kaha i te wā i roto i te Nether whenua kāinga whakaoho i te ahi.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_water_weakne: Ko te wai he waipiro e 1.5 nga kino i ia tuarua i te wai, i te ua ranei.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_night_vision: Ko te ahi o roto e whakamarama ana i ngā ana pōuri rawa.
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_scare_mobs.n: Ko te Aura o te Reinga
power.neoorigins.cinderborn_scare_mobs.d: Ko te nuinga o nga mea ora, he kararehe, he tangata whenua, he kararehe mohoao, ka rere atu i to aroaro o te ahi.
origins.neoorigins.sculkborn.name: Ko Sculkborn
origins.neoorigins.sculkborn.description: He mea o te pouri o te pouri he mea whakangungu, he aukati, he mea whakangao i te mana tangi engari he puhoi, he ngoikore i te marama o te ra, a he ngoikore i runga ake i te whenua.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_sonic_bolt.na: Ko te tangi o te tangi
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_sonic_bolt.de: E pupuhi ana i tētahi pōhēhē o te reo e pā ana ki te whānuitanga o te 7 tāwāhi, e rua ngā pūmau, e ono ngā hēkona te whakawera.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_darkness_aura: Ka whakaoho i tētahi pūngao tangi e waiho ana i tētahi mara pouri e noho tonu ana i muri i a ia. E toru te kaha, e 15 nga hēkona te whakawera.
Ka kite i te ao mā te wiri ko te pouri ehara i te arai.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_natural_armor: Te ātete pūmau I te papanga o te kōpaki matotoru e hopu ana i te kino e haere mai ana.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_knockback_res: He 50% te ātete ki te whakaheke.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_daylight_dama: Ko te Maui o te Mata
E rua nga kino i ia hēkona ka tukuna ki te marama o te ra.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_projectile_im: Ko te Whakakorenga o te Rongo
Ka hurihia ngā pere e ngā āpure wiri.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_vibration_sen: E whiti ana ngā mea ora e tata ana ka taea e koe te kite i to rātau nekehanga i roto i te whenua.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_slow_movement: E neke ana i te 15% iti ake i te ritenga.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_reduced_healt: -2 ngā ngākau (-4 HP mōrahi). Ko te tinana i hangaia i te hawhe o te whakapakoko he ngoikore.
origins.neoorigins.enderite.name: Ko te whakangahau
origins.neoorigins.enderite.description: He tangata whanau mai i te Whakamutunga rangatira o te whakawhitiwhitiwhiti me te whakatikatika, ataahua i te heke iho, engari he ngoikore ki te wai me te marama o te ra.
power.neoorigins.enderite_teleport.name: Taahiraa Whakatika
power.neoorigins.enderite_teleport.descr: E 32 ngā kōpae i te ara e titiro ana koe, e rua ngā pūngao, e toru ngā hēkona te whakawera.
power.neoorigins.enderite_phase.name: Ko te Wāhanga Kāore
power.neoorigins.enderite_phase.descript: Ngā wāhanga i roto i ngā taiepa mārō, e toru ngā pūngao, e 10 ngā hēkona te whakawera.
power.neoorigins.enderite_slow_fall.name: Ender Drift
power.neoorigins.enderite_slow_fall.desc: Ka hinga mā te ahuareka, me te mea e kore e kaha te kaha o te taimaha.
power.neoorigins.enderite_night_vision.d: Ka taea te kite mārama i roto i te pōuri tonu. Whakamahia te paatene Night Vision (te taunoa K).
power.neoorigins.enderite_scare_endermit: E rere ana ngā epara me ngā ika hiriwa i te kitenga.
power.neoorigins.enderite_water_damage.n: Te Whakapā Mai i te Ngaro
power.neoorigins.enderite_water_damage.d: E rua nga kino i ia hēkona mai i te whakapā ki te wai, ki te ua rānei.
power.neoorigins.enderite_daylight_weakn: E 50% atu ana te kino i te wa e pa ana ki te mahana o te ra.
